Aisha Khan: FYI vendor CSV import sent out ~120 invites with wrong locale and inverted opt-out values. Getting compliance warnings.
Noah Park: Oof. Which fields are incorrect?
Aisha Khan: Locale defaulted to en-GB instead of en-US for most, and opt_out_email is flipped (vendor uses 0=opt-out, 1=opt-in).
Maya Rodriguez: That could trigger duplicate reminders and send the wrong language. Need immediate rollback plan.
Noah Park: Is this the bulk-invite job from last night? job_id=2026-03-22-03:14
Aisha Khan: Yes. Sample: ```candidate_email,locale,opt_out_email
jane@example.com,en-GB,0
john@example.com,en-GB,1
```
Samir Patel: Our importer treats 0 as opt-in. I'll put a vendor-specific hotfix to invert the mapping for Greenfield until they fix the feed.
Recruiting Bot: :warning: 118 invites sent in job 2026-03-22-03:14. Delivery 100%.
Maya Rodriguez: Immediate actions: pause ATS reminder queue; generate impacted list for comms; backfill locales; re-map opt-outs and send correction where needed.
Noah Park: Pausing reminder queue now. Snapshot taken.
Samir Patel: Running query to list affected candidates: ```SELECT id,email,locale,opt_out_email FROM candidates WHERE source_vendor='greenfield' AND created_at>='2026-03-22';```
Recruiting Bot: Query queued, est rows: 118.
Samir Patel: Patch ready: importer will apply opt_out_email = 1 - value when vendor='greenfield'. Adding unit test + CI check for vendor boolean semantics and locale whitelist (en-US,en-GB,fr-FR).
Aisha Khan: Can you also produce the candidate list so Comms can review messages?
Maya Rodriguez: Draft in #people-ops-drafts: "Hi X — we sent invite emails with incorrect language/communication settings. We've fixed this and apologize. Reply to opt-out immediately." Legal to review.
Noah Park: After patch, re-run import in staging and run sanity script.
Samir Patel: Dry-run passed: 118/118 locales normalized, opt_out normalized. Deploying hotfix to prod after approvals.
Aisha Khan: Vendor responded — acknowledged schema mismatch, will provide corrected feed by EOD.
Maya Rodriguez: Logging incident for monthly ops review and prepping a short RCA note.
Noah Park: Retro action: add vendor schema contract + sample CSV to onboarding checklist.
Aisha Khan: Assignments: Samir - importer patch/tests; Noah - pause/verify queue + re-run; Maya - candidate comms; Aisha - vendor escalation. Blocking until vendor confirms fixed feed. :thumbsup:
